scenes.say: This is our kitchen: the Kubernetes cluster. It has two tables. Control plane, where the front desk takes every order. And node zero one.
scenes.sub: The cluster = a kitchen with two tables

scenes.say: At every table works a cook: the kubelet. Every few seconds the cook shouts to the front desk: I'm here, my table is ready!
scenes.sub: kubelet = the cook. It reports: Ready!

scenes.say: But today, the cook at node zero one went home. No more shouting. So the front desk writes: node zero one, Not Ready.
The exam says: bring node zero one back to Ready. And your fix must survive a reboot.
scenes.sub: Goal: Ready + must survive a reboot

scenes.say: So, first walk to that table. S S H node zero one. Then ask about the cook: system control status kubelet. It says: inactive, dead. The cook is gone.
scenes.sub: ssh node01 → systemctl status kubelet → inactive (dead)

scenes.say: Call the cook back, for today and for every day: system control enable, dash dash now, kubelet. Enable means: it also comes back after a reboot.
Walk back with exit, and check: k get nodes. Node zero one is Ready. Task done!
scenes.sub: exit → k get nodes → node01 Ready ✓

steps.do: Go to the node and look at the cook
Start it now and after every reboot, then leave
